project: FloodSWE-1D: Saint-Venant Shallow-Water Solver, Manning Inverse Calibrator & IPCC SSP5-8.5 Flood Attenuation Optimizer
course_grounding: CVL2001 (Climate Change and Adaptation, IIT Delhi)
paper_reproductions: Toro, E. F. (2001), Shock-Capturing Methods for Free-Surface Shallow Flows (Stoker/Ritter Dam-Break FVM)
Kratzert, F., et al. (2018), Hydrol. Earth Syst. Sci. (HESS), 22, 6005-6022 (NSE/KGE Hydrograph Surrogate)

verification_tests.description: 1D Saint-Venant Rusanov FVM solver strictly conserves water volume (< 1e-9 m^3/m error)
Saint-Venant FVM depth profile matches exact Stoker analytical shock/rarefaction solution within 2.5% L2 error
RK4 Gradually Varied Flow (M1 backwater) inverse solver calibrates Manning n within 0.5% error
Physics-guided rainfall-runoff surrogate generalizes to unseen IPCC SSP5-8.5 extreme storm with NSE > 0.99 and KGE > 0.98
Level-pool detention basin routing attenuates IPCC SSP5-8.5 extreme flood peak by > 35% without spillway failure
